note: Election of county councillors for the County of Londonderry, polled Thursday 4 June 1964 with the rural district elections (Londonderry Sentinel, 3 June 1964, p. 1, put the local elections at 'to-morrow'; results were declared at Limavady on 5 June, Sentinel, 10 June 1964, p. 15). Nominations closed on 21 May: the Derry Journal of 22 May 1964 (p. 11) reported two contests, Faughanvale and Dungiven, and seventeen members returned unopposed. The Returning Officer's 'Notice of Result of Elections 1964' (Sentinel, 10 June 1964, p. 27) names all nineteen. Three-cornered contest; the official Unionist ran the sitting Nationalist to 43 votes.
